data.exact_reserve_text: The 2015 net technical result of GBP 24.0m (2014: GBP 48.6m) includes GBP 29.0m (2014: GBP 27.7m) of releases from reserves in respect of prior accident years.
data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate experienced a gross release of GBP 8.592 million from reserves relating to prior accident years, representing a 1.504% reduction in opening gross claims outstanding. This favorable development is calculated from the gross claims development triangle. The report also notes a net release of GBP 29.0 million from prior accident years, contributing to the overall net technical result. The managing agent's report indicates that no adverse run-off deviation is envisaged, supporting the favorable claims development.
